title: Jesus Weeps Over Jerusalem
description: When Jesus approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it and said: 'If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes.' He warned that enemies would build a rampart against the city, surround it, and level it to the ground, leaving not one stone upon another, because it did not recognize the time when God visited it.

versions.title: Jesus Weeps Over Jerusalem
versions.description: When Jesus approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it and said: 'If only you had known on this day what would bring peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes. Days will come upon you when your enemies will build a rampart around you, surround you, and close in on you from every side... because you did not recognize the time when the Lord visited you.'
versions.reason: [minor] description: The description had rendered 'your eyes' as 'your eyes' (reversed) and was missing 'your peace'. Minor adjustment to be faithful to the text.
